claim: Coherent orientation is induced by stabilized triadic closure of distinction-nodes.

must_establish.requirement: Orientation coherence increases as a function of closure duration.
Randomized initial orientation converges toward coherence in persistent triads.
must_establish.formal_need: M0_v2 (random start) converges to coherent state.

must_establish.requirement: Orientation drift is bounded by triadic stability.

hypothesis.H0: Orientation coherence remains random regardless of triadic stability.
hypothesis.H1: Triadic stability induces orientation alignment (C_orient growth).
